name: playwright-agentic-framework
description: MCP-optional agentic Playwright harness for standardized AI-assisted UI automation with CLI evidence, capture workflows, context graphs, and trace-first debugging.

scripts.test: npm run source:manifest:crm -- --quiet && npx playwright test
scripts.test:smoke: npm run source:manifest:crm -- --quiet && npx playwright test --grep @smoke
scripts.test:headed: npm run source:manifest:crm -- --quiet && npx playwright test --headed --project=chromium
scripts.test:debug: npm run source:manifest:crm -- --quiet && npx playwright test --debug --project=chromium
scripts.test:ui: npm run source:manifest:crm -- --quiet && npx playwright test --ui
scripts.test:auth: npm run source:manifest:crm -- --quiet && npx playwright test tests/auth.setup.ts --project=setup
scripts.sample:crm:test: npm run source:manifest:crm -- --quiet && npx playwright test tests/sample-crm.spec.ts --project=chromium
